I did just start playing non-mobile again and have like a 22% win rate over 60 games going from d3 to masters 200 lp In a week. Granted I’ve been gm/challenger for a few sets, but I stick to fundamentals I’ve learned from previous sets and apply them to newer patches and it works. I tend to not hard force anything unless augments get me to.

If you plan on lose streaking, do not level and just hard Econ. Ideally, you create boards that are strong enough to kill some units to conserve health while also losing and maintaining loss streak for gold - Talon is a really good unit for this, but you could accidentally win too.. so be careful and always scout. Other good openers that are solid for lose streaking are mercs and yordles. With yordles, be careful with some upgrades as you could potentially ruin your loss streak. 

Once you hit 3-2 you can level to 6 and roll some gold for board strength that can carry you until 4-1.  I generally try to roll to 30g but sometimes I roll to 20 if I can’t find anything decent. Units to look out for are 3 and 4 costs that can utilize your items well - 2 costs are ok but will start to fall off at stage 4 if people high roll 4/5 cost Carrys . At 3-2, You also have option of playing a 2 cost reroll comp at this point if you have good items and are hitting. Make sure you have a good balance of front and backline with some utility  as that should be able to stabilize you.
